title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode7 Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What happened? Where are we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is that a stage? There's another one over there, too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were just on the rooftop, weren't we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What is this place? It doesn't feel like a dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here too! I was worried I was alone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
There sure are a lot of glow sticks.
Is there a show about to start or something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yep! That's right, Minori!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! M-Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku! The show's about to start! Oh?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You all finally came! We've been waiting for you, you know!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Rin's here too?! Oh my gosh! Am I actually shaking Rin's hand right now?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What in the world is going on?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Miku and Rin are VIRTUAL SINGERS, aren't they? So how is it that we can talk to and touch them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's because we're in a world created by your combined feelings!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A world created by our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yep! This SEKAI is created by the feelings you four have for idols!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're here to help others discover their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! True feelings are transformed into new songs in this world♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Though it looks like you haven't figured out what those true feelings are yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Feelings turn into songs?
What exactly does that mean?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Explanations will have to wait until later!
Right now, we just want you to enjoy our show♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! We came up with this show just for you in the hopes it would cheer you all up! Please enjoy it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, does this mean we actually get to watch a real show with Miku and Rin?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, come here a second.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Sure—ow ow OW!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why did you pinch me?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I just wanted to make sure this wasn't a dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You could have pinched your own cheek, you know...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It looks like they're about to start.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi, everyone! Miku here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And me, Rin♪ Thank you all for coming out to see us today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll do our best to make sure you all enjoy the show! So without further ado, here's our first song!
song00002_off_f

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! She just winked at us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How can you be having fun right now? We don't even know what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sing along, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone looks like they're having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The cute costumes, the atmosphere, the shining lights... I hope I can put on a show like this someday.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, I definitely will! I'm going to become an idol for sure!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ready? Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They're perfectly in sync. They must really trust each other to be able to do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is exactly the kind of show I always wanted to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure you all know this next song!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Look at that! Everybody's glow sticks turned blue!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (It's the same as when Haruka did songs solo. Hehe. I remember waving my glow sticks like crazy that night.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, but now that Haruka has quit, I guess that means I won't be able to see this again.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It reminds me of the ocean.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When you're on stage and everyone's glow sticks turn blue, it's like looking out at an ocean.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
All those happy, smiling faces bathed in a cool, blue light.
It was so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I won't ever see it again, though...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hurray! Another great success today♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So what did you think of the show, everyone?
Did it help cheer you up?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! It was great! I'm re-energized and ready to get back to work tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh♪ I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why did everybody turn their glow sticks blue, though? I would've figured they'd be green for Miku or yellow for Rin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's because your feelings take shape here
in this world.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Feelings take shape?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Miku. Rin.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for letting us watch your show.
It was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But could you send us home now, please?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?
